key_claims.claim: Interpretable AI reanalysis of the STRASS RCT identifies liposarcoma subsets that benefit from preoperative radiotherapy, refining the original null overall finding
A cardiac MRI-derived risk score outperforms standard clinical calculators for predicting heart failure hospitalization or cardiovascular death in type 2 diabetes
Greater popliteal artery wall thickness on MRI is associated with worse knee osteoarthritis pain and radiographic progression
Five-year CT follow-up identifies distinct growth trajectories and independent risk factors for progression of small pure ground-glass nodules
The MORGOTH EEG foundation model achieves expert-level performance across diverse neurological interpretation tasks validated at 48 external institutions
